basic_details.short_information: District Health and Family Welfare Society Vijayapura (DHFWS Vijayapura) Staff Nurse, Lab Technician & Pharmacist Notification 2026 has been released on 28 July 2026 on the official website. A total of 26 vacancies have been announced through the DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026.

age_limit.details: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Age relaxation rules will be as per government norms.

qualification.education_qualification: B.Sc Nursing / Diploma Nursing, DMLT, D Pharmacy
qualification.details: Staff Nurse: B.Sc Nursing (25%) or Diploma Nursing (75%) from Karnataka Government recognized institute and registered with Karnataka Nursing Council. Lab Technician: DMLT from Karnataka Government recognized institute. Pharmacist: D Pharmacy from Karnataka Government recognized institute and registered with Karnataka Pharmacy Council.

how_to_apply: Candidates who wish to apply for DHFWS Vijayapura Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below.
Read the official notification carefully before applying.
Download the application form from the official website: .
Fill the application form carefully with correct information.
Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates.
Check all details carefully before submission.
Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed.
Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 07-08-2026.
Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply for the DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 is 07 August 2026. Candidates are advised to submit their applications well before this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Staff Nurse post?
faq.answer: There are 16 vacancies available for the Staff Nurse post in the DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the minimum qualification required for the Lab Technician post?
faq.answer: The minimum qualification required for the Lab Technician post is DMLT from a Karnataka Government recognized institute.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the maximum age limit for the posts?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the posts (Staff Nurse, Lab Technician, Pharmacist) is 45 years.

faq.question: Q6. What is the selection process for these posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these posts will include Document Verification and an Interview.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The mode of application for DHFWS Vijayapura Recruitment 2026 is offline. Candidates need to download the application form and submit it via post or in person.
